identity.description: FanBasis (fanbasis.com) is described by third parties as a creator economy platform for monetizing content, selling digital products via checkout, and managing subscriptions and members. The official site (403) and the GitHub repo FanBasis/fbnewapi (404) could not be read, so official-source details are unverified.
identity.identity_notes: Only third-party sources describe the product. Name collisions exist: Fanvue (api.fanvue.com), Openstage Fanbase API (openstage.live), and the Fanbase identity platform (fb-apidocs.pages.dev) are different products.

auth.scopes_notes: Unofficial mirror/search snippet says API keys carry scopes and a 'webhooks' scope covers webhook-subscription routes. Not verified on an official page.

write_ops: Send test event to a subscription
api.limitations: Official docs (docs.fanbasis.com, FanBasis/fbnewapi) were not readable. Endpoint details come only from unofficial mirrors and search snippets. Rate limits, key issuance, and sandbox details are not established.

open_questions: Is fanbasis.com's official developer documentation (docs.fanbasis.com or similar) reachable, and does it confirm the x-api-key header?
How do developers obtain API keys: self-serve dashboard, paid plan, or admin/partner approval?
Is there a sandbox or test mode, and what are the rate limits?
Does the official FanBasis/fbnewapi GitHub repo exist and is it owned by FanBasis? The fetch returned 404.
Full webhook event list and signature verification method are unconfirmed.
